description: Roster of people who worked on (pre-merger) DeepMind / Google DeepMind technical AI safety: early safety team (2016-), Safety Analysis, Robust & Verified AI, Scalable Alignment, Alignment, AGI Safety & Alignment Team (ASAT), mech interp, Frontier Safety / dangerous-capability evals, causal alignment, and safety-relevant Ethics/Responsibility contributors. tier: lead|core|contributor|intern|external (external = frequent non-DM collaborators, filter out if you only want staff). years are approximate (~) unless stated; inferred from DM-affiliated publications and public bios.
method: Medium post list from Medium profile-stream JSON (via r.jina.ai) + sitemap; bylines from post bodies; Substack archive API; LW/AF GraphQL + search API for user slugs/ids and team posts; arXiv API author queries for ~63 core people filtered to DM tenure windows; ASAT externally-advised-papers sheet.
